rule: Statement-level evidence only. NO premise adjudication in this phase.

statement_ledger.exact_statement: We derive the quantum theory from five physical requirements... [full axioms and probability-structure extraction required from full text]
statement_ledger.location: arXiv:1004.1483v4 abstract + Sec. I-V (full text pending depth extraction)
statement_ledger.extraction_notes: five requirements: (1) finite-dimensional systems connected by continuous reversible transformations; (2) the existence of a generic system; (3) no information without disturbance; (4) the composition rule; (5) local measurability. Probabilities enter as part of the reconstructed state-space structure; the exact location must be pinned from the full text before Phase-2A adjudication.

statement_ledger.exact_statement: A subsystem of a random system with wave function psi is random with distribution given by the probability measure rho(x) = |psi(x)|^2 ('the appearance of randomness precisely as given by the probability measure rho=|psi|^2').
statement_ledger.extraction_notes: separate evidence objects required for Phase-2A: guidance dynamics / equivariance / rho=|psi|^2 / typicality. The abstract states the randomness result; its derivational status is a Phase-2A question.

statement_ledger.exact_statement: The Born rule is shown to arise dynamically. Non-standard distributions rho != |psi|^2 relax toward |psi|^2, with a coarse-grained H-function decreasing approximately exponentially.
statement_ledger.location: arXiv:quant-ph/0403034v2 abstract; Proc. R. Soc. Lond. A 461, 253 (2005)
statement_ledger.extraction_notes: H = integral dx rho log(rho/|psi|^2) (minus relative entropy). Phase-2A must determine whether relaxation constitutes derivation, conditional derivation, or typicality-imported structure.

statement_ledger.exact_statement: A modification of the dynamics is 'postulated also for microscopic systems'; the resulting dynamics 'forbids the occurrence of linear superpositions of states localized in far-away spatial regions'; the model 'provides the basis for a conceptually appealing description of quantum measurement'.
statement_ledger.extraction_notes: The stochastic localization law, its parameters, and the probability statement are extracted from full text in Phase-2A. The abstract already records that the modification is POSTULATED (not derived from standard dynamics) -- a key Phase-2A premise datum.

coverage_note: Phase-1E adds live-verified route-defining primaries for R5-R8 at ABSTRACT_VERIFIED level. Full-text assumption extraction is a Phase-2A input task, permitted there under the frozen schema.
